note: BL-17, owner 2026-11-12: the Dragon at 3 x 3, THREE different concepts (the owner asked for three), one image each: A seated (green, grounded, wings half-open), B flying (steel blue, hovering with wings spread like the Demon and the Phoenix), C a coiled wingless wyrm (crimson and gold, seen from the higher camera). None installed until the owner picks.

dragon-seated.prompt: RENDERING REFERENCE: the attached COW on magenta is one of this game's animals: match its rendering (soft painterly, flat colour with gentle shading, soft thick outlines, no texture, no background). STYLE REFERENCE, the most important image: the attached farm man on magenta is an APPROVED character of this game. The new creature must look drawn by the same hand on the same day, for the same storybook: the same chunky doll proportion (a big head, large expressive eyes, a short thick body, small feet), the same soft rendering; never realistic, never anatomical, never gory. THIS IS AN ENEMY the player fights: menacing in a storybook way (a scowl, bared teeth, a glare), but still charming and readable, something a child would call a monster and not be frightened by; no blood, no wounds. VIEW, the rule for every enemy: FRONT-FACING, like the player characters: facing the viewer, the body square-ish to the viewer with a FAINT three-quarter turn, the head and the eyes turned a little toward the viewer's RIGHT, left and right sides roughly symmetrical. SIBLINGS: the attached red DEMON, the attached PHOENIX and the attached OGRE are approved enemies of this game: the dragon is the biggest of that set and must look painted by the same hand: the same simple rounded shapes, clean flat-ish colour with gentle soft shading, soft thick outlines, a clear readable face with big angry eyes. SUBJECT, concept A, THE SEATED DRAGON: a classic storybook DRAGON sitting upright on its haunches like a huge guard dog, facing the viewer, heavy and grounded. Emerald-green scales with a broad cream-yellow plated belly; a big head held high on a thick neck with a long snout, two curved ivory horns, a row of dark green spines down the neck, nostrils flared, narrowed golden eyes and a toothy scowl with the mouth shut; two front legs planted straight down in front of it with big clawed feet; the hind legs folded at its sides; two bat wings HALF-OPEN, rising behind the shoulders like a cloak, dark green with a paler membrane; the thick tail curled round on the ground beside its feet, ending in an arrow tip. It sits on ONE flat ground line. It holds NOTHING and breathes NO fire in the picture: no flame, no smoke, no sparks, no glow spilling onto the background; every part is OPAQUE. Keep it at the game's scale: it is seen about 140 pixels wide on the board, so big plain shapes, a strong silhouette, scales suggested by a few large shapes and never drawn one by one, no fine detail. COLOUR: never pink, never magenta, never purple anywhere on it. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a pure magenta (#FF00FF) field with a thin grid, a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle (one board tile) and a dashed half-height box directly above it (the headroom); the reference character stands in that box with its head in the headroom. ONE FIGURE ONLY, nothing else in the picture: no building, no props on the ground, no scene. This is the game's largest creature: IGNORE the box for its size and FILL THE PICTURE, leaving only a small margin of magenta on every side; the reference character would stand no higher than its knee. Draw it sitting on the ground: about as wide as it is tall. A soft contact shadow directly under it; leave every other pixel pure solid magenta: no grass, no ground, no frame, no text.
